odia: ଲୁଣ ଖାଇବା ଯାହାର, ଗୁଣ ଗାଇ ତାହାର
title: Whose salt, whose praise?
literal_meaning: Eat someone’s salt; sing that person’s merits.
explanation: Salt stands for livelihood received through service in the dictionary definition. The line links material dependence with praise of the provider. It may express loyalty, or make a sharp comment about praise shaped by dependence; the occasion decides the force. It does not establish that every employee’s praise is dishonest or that support requires silence.
meaning_odia: ଏଠି ଲୁଣ ଖାଇବା କେବଳ ଖାଦ୍ୟର କଥା ନୁହେଁ; ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଏହା କାହା ଅଧୀନରେ ଚାକିରି କରି ଜୀବିକା ଚଳାଇବା। ଯାହାଠାରୁ ଜୀବିକା ମିଳେ ତାହାର ପ୍ରଶଂସା କରିବା ସହ କଥାଟି ଯୋଡ଼େ। କେବେ ଏହା ଆନୁଗତ୍ୟର କଥା, କେବେ ନିର୍ଭରତା ପାଇଁ ହେଉଥିବା ପ୍ରଶଂସାକୁ ଟାହି। ସବୁ କର୍ମଚାରୀଙ୍କ ପ୍ରଶଂସା ମିଛ କିମ୍ବା ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ନେଲେ ଚୁପ୍ ରହିବାକୁ ହେବ ବୋଲି ଅର୍ଥ ନୁହେଁ।
english_summary: The salt image connects livelihood with loyalty—or praise shaped by dependence.
odia_summary: ଜୀବିକା ଓ ପ୍ରଶଂସାର ସମ୍ପର୍କକୁ ଲୁଣର ଛବି ଧରେ।
usage_example: After hearing an adviser praise every decision of the person who pays them, a listener quietly repeats the line. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
cultural_context: Service meaning is sourced; two possible conversational tones are editorial. Companion refusal wording is recorded separately, not counted as another saying.
